name: savvy-progress
description: Terminal bar above the prompt that always says what the session is doing and what the turn and the session cost, with the weather if a place is set, plus an agents bar and a live agents panel (/agents-info). Fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit savvy-progress 1.2.0.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

barColor.title: Bar color (terminal)
barColor.description: The color of the bar and its sliding block in a terminal, as a hex color such as #0079d2 or #f80; anything else leaves the default

paneBackground.title: Panel background (terminal)
paneBackground.description: A color painted over the panel in a terminal, such as the terminal's own background; empty leaves the engine's

weatherPlace.title: Weather place
weatherPlace.description: Latitude and longitude for the weather in the bar, as lat,lon (for example 52.37,4.90); empty leaves the weather off. Asked from open-meteo.com every half hour.
